title: SecureFlow Configuration Schema
description: JSON Schema for SecureFlow configuration file (.secureflow.json) controlling security gate thresholds, path-specific rules, and monorepo policy scopes.

$schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema for validation and editor autocompletion.

$comment.description: Optional comment or documentation explaining this configuration.

gate.description: Security gate thresholds and rule overrides for PR merge and CI checks.

blockOn.description: Severity threshold that blocks PR merge or pipeline execution.

reviewOn.description: Severity threshold that flags findings for manual reviewer sign-off.

type.description: Vulnerability type or category name to override (e.g. 'Hardcoded Secrets', 'SQL Injection').

paths.description: Path-specific severity threshold overrides matching file glob patterns.

policyScopes.description: Path-scoped security policy rules defined within the gate section.

includeDefaults.description: Whether to apply built-in default ignore patterns (lockfiles, minified files, vendor/, etc.). Defaults to true.

forceInclude.description: List of glob patterns to force include in scanning, overriding default ignore rules.

skipDrafts.description: Whether to skip security scans for draft pull requests until marked ready for review.

skipAuthors.description: List of pull request author logins or glob patterns (e.g. 'dependabot[bot]', '*bot*') to skip scanning.

skipAuthors.description: List of pull request author logins or glob patterns (e.g. 'dependabot[bot]', '*bot*') to skip scanning.

includeDefaults.description: Whether to apply built-in default ignore patterns (lockfiles, minified files, vendor/, etc.). Defaults to true.

includeDefaults.description: Whether to apply built-in default ignore patterns.

forceInclude.description: List of glob patterns to force include in scanning.

policyScopes.description: Path-scoped policy rules (enable/disable specific policies for paths in monorepos).

paths.description: Glob patterns specifying which files or directories this policy rule applies to.

enable.description: Names of policy categories or checks to enable for matched paths.

disable.description: Names of policy categories or checks to disable for matched paths.
